name: James's Roasted Pork Tenderloin
whyItWorks: Pork tenderloin is as lean and tender as chicken breast, and pairing it with smooth polenta or white rice keeps insoluble fiber near zero.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with the smooth polenta or plain mashed potatoes/white rice, ask for the Cajun Andouille pork jus on the side, and skip any pickled onion or greens garnish.
watchOuts: Collard greens or fibrous vegetable sides
